services.name: Embraer Flight Simulators
services.desc: Slip into the captain’s seat and take the commands of a virtual aircraft in one of our four cockpit chairs. Sharpen your takeoff and landing skills using one of the most realistic, detailed, and user-friendly computer simulator software available to the public; recognized for pilot certification by the FAA. Choose your aircraft, select a flight plan, and take to the skies. But be careful not to get too comfortable, our guest pilots might use the Instructor Operation Station to throw a thunderstorm your way!
